summary: The registrant Smartbird, Inc. (f/k/a Allbirds, Inc.) filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of Dr. Nadia Carlsten as President, CEO, Secretary, and Class I director, effective June 18, 2026, following a board decision on June 12, 2026. The filing also includes an amendment to increase a senior secured convertible note facility by $50M to $100M aggregate principal, with a conversion price of $4.00 on the incremental amount. No departure details, advisor names, or compensation terms are disclosed. What to watch: any strategic shift signaled by the new CEO and note issuance terms.
